story_type: missing boater found alone in a swamped jon boat far offshore, cutter boat crew pickup
hook: 12 miles out, in a 12 foot boat that was half underwater.
narration: He was twelve miles off Florida, in a twelve foot boat that was half underwater.
His family had reported him missing. The next morning, a Coast Guard HC-130 crew spotted him, still sitting in the swamped boat.
A boat crew from the Cutter Coho raced out to him.
Sun glare like this can hide a person in the water, even from a few yards away.
[short pause] Then they pulled him out of the sea and into their boat.
His swamped jon boat came along too, tied to their side.
outcome: The Coho crew handed him to a Station Mayport crew, who took him to waiting paramedics. No medical concerns were reported.
title: 12 miles out in a sinking 12 foot boat
description:
A 25-year-old reported missing by his family was found 12 miles off St. Augustine, Florida, on Aug. 5, 2023, sitting in his partially submerged 12-foot jon boat. A Coast Guard Cutter Coho boat crew recovered him.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/892771/coast-guard-rescues-man-12-miles-offshore-st-augustine
